title: Agentic iOS Development with RocketSim and RocketTrace
summary: Antoine van der Lee shares four workflows that combine Simulator navigation, accessibility audits, analytics, screenshots, and Instruments findings with a plan reviewed before edits. An iOS team can require evidence for each proposed change and repeat the measurement afterward; his reported accessibility score improved, but device remeasurement of the performance fixes was still pending.
takeaway: Review the audit or trace evidence before approving edits, instrument unattributed hitches instead of guessing, and rerun the same device scenario before claiming a performance improvement.

media.alt: SwiftLee’s prompt for navigating an iOS app with RocketSim while recording and analyzing its performance with RocketTrace
